PBA Tuesday Night Ladies Ride

Plano, TX · West Plano · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

PBA Tuesday Night Ladies Ride is a road group ride in Plano, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from NE corner of Windhaven and Communications Pkwy (west side of the building, by the Pinstack lot). About 24–31 miles, no-drop; C group 15.5–17 mph, D group 14–15.5 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 5–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the PBA Tuesday Night Ladies Ride group ride

A women's developmental road ride run by Plano Bicycle Association. Two groups, both no-drop, 24 to 31 miles. White front and red rear lights are required. Routes change, so check the ride posting on the club blog.
